note: Nomination-day report for the fourteen divisions of Newry No. 1 (County Down) rural district, one member each. There was no contest; Mr. Pierce P. Fegan took Carrickcrossan in place of Mr. James Gorman, who retired, and four retiring members (Messrs. J. M'Connell, P. M'Ateer, A. J. M'Clean and E. J. Convery) were not nominated and held their seats, but their divisions were not printed. Filed on 1930-05-30, the Co. Down county and rural district polling day that year (previously filed under 1930-06-05; moved 6 Nov 2026). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
